run_replay_action_logs: run the replay script on a log directory to compute and report rewards from action logs
replay_trajectory_rewards: replay recorded action trajectories and compute mean median and std reward statistics
generate_reward_report: generate a reward.json report file with mean median and std from replayed action logs
replay_single_action_log: replay a single action log file against test data to compute its reward
validate_policy_evaluation: validate policy evaluation results by replaying action logs and comparing computed rewards
